_README: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR D5(b). One member, one model, one key.
FILL THIS IN ON THE DAY, NOT BEFORE. Model ids and prices move, and the
brief requires the price to be verified on the day and the date recorded.
validate_roster() refuses any model still set to a <placeholder>, and
refuses a price_checked_on older than 14 days - so an unfilled roster
costs a refusal, never a wrong number.
THE TWO CONDITIONS ARE CHECKED IN CODE, not left to memory:
no two v2 members share a family, and the v2 set spans >=2 tiers.
Exactly one member runs v1, on a model a v2 member already ran -
comparing prompt versions means holding the MODEL fixed.
trials_expected is DERIVED from the fixtures and merely cross-checked
against the number below. If they disagree the roster is wrong, never
battery_tag is resolved to a commit SHA at runtime. Cut the tag, then
nobody runs until `git rev-list -n1 <tag>` equals their HEAD.
trial_policy: 30 ordinary x1 + 10 negative x3 = 60 (derived; see battery_provenance.plan_shape)

expected._note: Filled by `python3 run_battery.py --freeze` once, at the frozen commit. Every later run compares against these and refuses on a mismatch, naming the component that moved.

members._note: THE v1 PASS. Must be the SAME model as rohit's, so the only variable is our own writing. Blocked until tools.DESCRIPTORS_V1 is written - the runner refuses while sha(v1) == sha(v2).
